supersession_reason: The first independent version-nine review showed that an external byte-identical configuration copy could still authorize the legacy review exception and that the first review and review manifest identities were not bound. Version ten permits new synthesis only from the source-derived canonical configuration path and digest, keeps direct review parsing fail-closed, and binds the legacy exception to the frozen first review, second review and manifest digests. It preserves all component evidence and scientific results.
purpose: Synthesize the complete closed synthetic-truth validation chain and state exactly which numerical, identification and forecast claims are supported, rejected or still unknown.

decision_rules.numerical_chain_validated: Every component evidence summary passes, every evidence manifest verifies, every available first review passes with zero must-fix items, and every available second raw-evidence validation confirms it with zero must-fix items. New synthesis requires the source-derived canonical configuration path and digest. Direct review parsing never receives a legacy exception. Verdicts use exact normalized allowlists; every registered fix signal is authoritative even when alone; duplicate fix signals must agree; all concurrent decision texts must be positive; only registered contradiction counters and decision-like fields are accepted; the sole legacy list requires the canonical evidence path plus frozen first-review, second-review and manifest digests; invalid types, negative counts, unrecognized fields and inconsistent decisions fail closed.
decision_rules.joint_identification_supported: The complete nine-filter method must pass its preregistered joint-identification rule in at least one final condition.
decision_rules.joint_added_value_supported: At least one final one-, three-, or seven-day target must meet the preregistered added-value rule beyond both parameter-only and process-scale-only methods.
decision_rules.broad_scientific_claim: A broad claim is authorized only if numerical-chain, joint-identification and joint-added-value rules all pass without unresolved scope-changing uncertainty.
decision_rules.validation_goal_complete: The validation goal is complete when every planned component, fixed-label condition, assimilation-length boundary and seven-day switching pressure condition has reproducible evidence and two independent review layers; scientific outcomes may be negative.

scope_limit: The synthesis covers the frozen fifteen-state hydrological model, three complete thirteen-parameter vectors, three pre-projection process-scale candidates, eight matched blocks, fixed-label assimilation of seven, twenty-one and forty-five days, and one seven-day simultaneous parameter/process switching pressure condition. It does not validate real-basin performance, untested assimilation durations above forty-five days, other switch periods or transition priors, other observation uncertainty, forcing error, or an exact post-projection additive Gaussian process model.
